title: Body-processor metadata can read an out-of-root request body through an artifact-derived case ID
title_de: Body-Processor-Metadaten können über eine artefaktabgeleitete Case-ID einen Request-Body außerhalb der Safe Root lesen
connector: nginx branch validated; Apache and HAProxy branches share the generator pattern but were not independently reproduced
trust_boundary: artifact-derived case metadata (case_id) crossing into a CI report reader that otherwise uses configured safe-root containment
sink: request_body_bytes() directly read_bytes() config_path.parent / request-body.bin and is the confirmed content-read/disclosure sink; generated_body_length() has an unguarded is_file() existence probe, but its subsequent read_text() path already applies safe-root gating before content is read
summary: At Parent source revision 9f23ae2c5fe908cef38f203be03f93fda75a8dd7, a controlled pre-fix NGINX probe proved that an artifact-derived case_id of ../../../outside can move the generated request-body candidate outside the configured safe root. request_body_bytes() then read the external conf/request-body.bin sentinel and emitted its preview and matching SHA-256 while the legitimate in-root control remained readable. The probe does not establish an external content disclosure through generated_body_length().
summary_de: Auf Parent-Source-Revision 9f23ae2c5fe908cef38f203be03f93fda75a8dd7 bewies ein kontrollierter Pre-Fix-NGINX-Probe, dass eine artefaktabgeleitete Case-ID ../../../outside den generierten Request-Body-Kandidaten außerhalb der konfigurierten Safe Root verschieben kann. request_body_bytes() las danach den externen Sentinel conf/request-body.bin und gab dessen Vorschau sowie passende SHA-256 aus, während die legitime In-Root-Kontrolle lesbar blieb. Der Probe belegt keine externe Content-Offenlegung über generated_body_length().
observed_behavior: The baseline generated_config_path() concatenates entry['case_id'] into a path derived from a safe evidence file. On the NGINX branch, request_body_bytes() directly reads config_path.parent / request-body.bin instead of first calling safe_existing_file(); that is the confirmed disclosure sink. generated_body_length() also constructs the candidate and performs an unguarded is_file() probe, but its later read_text() path already applies safe-root gating before content is read. The focused probe configured SAFE_ROOTS to its temporary safe root, kept the evidence and case file in that root, supplied case_id ../../../outside, and observed vulnerability_reproduced:true with an out-of-root sentinel preview and matching digest.
observed_behavior_de: Die Baseline generated_config_path() hängt entry['case_id'] an einen aus einer sicheren Evidence-Datei abgeleiteten Pfad an. Im NGINX-Zweig liest request_body_bytes() config_path.parent / request-body.bin direkt, statt zuerst safe_existing_file() aufzurufen; dies ist der bestätigte Offenlegungs-Sink. generated_body_length() konstruiert den Kandidaten ebenfalls und führt eine ungeschützte is_file()-Existenzprüfung aus, aber sein späterer read_text()-Pfad wendet Safe-Root-Gating bereits vor dem Content-Read an. Der fokussierte Probe konfigurierte SAFE_ROOTS auf seinen temporären Safe Root, beließ Evidence- und Case-Datei in diesem Root, übergab case_id ../../../outside und beobachtete vulnerability_reproduced:true mit einer Out-of-Root-Sentinel-Vorschau und passendem Digest.
expected_behavior: Every request-body read used by body-processor report metadata remains beneath a configured safe root after all artifact-derived path segments are resolved. A case_id must not bypass the existing path-read control; a rejected external body must fall back to the already supported in-record request body behavior.
expected_behavior_de: Jeder für Body-Processor-Report-Metadaten verwendete Request-Body-Read bleibt nach Auflösung aller artefaktabgeleiteten Pfadsegmente unter einer konfigurierten Safe Root. Eine Case-ID darf das bestehende Path-Read-Control nicht umgehen; ein abgewiesener externer Body muss auf das bereits unterstützte In-Record-Request-Body-Verhalten zurückfallen.
impact: A party able to supply a body-processor artifact record with a traversal-bearing case_id can cause request_body_bytes() in this report generator to disclose the preview and SHA-256 of an accessible out-of-root file only when that file is named conf/request-body.bin at the selected parent path. The fixed suffix limits filename selection. The reproduction does not establish an external content disclosure through generated_body_length(), a normal hosted-CI attacker path, arbitrary filename read, file write, code execution, secret exposure, or external publication of the report.
impact_de: Eine Partei, die einen Body-Processor-Artefakt-Record mit traversalhaltiger Case-ID liefern kann, kann request_body_bytes() in diesem Report-Generator dazu bringen, Vorschau und SHA-256 einer erreichbaren Datei außerhalb der Root offenzulegen, jedoch nur wenn diese Datei am ausgewählten Parent-Pfad conf/request-body.bin heißt. Das feste Suffix begrenzt die Dateinamenauswahl. Die Reproduktion belegt keine externe Content-Offenlegung über generated_body_length(), keinen normalen Hosted-CI-Angreiferpfad, keinen beliebigen Dateiread, keinen File-Write, keine Codeausführung, keine Secret-Exposition und keine externe Veröffentlichung des Reports.
preconditions: The body-processor generator configures at least one SAFE_ROOTS entry and processes an evidence/case record whose declared evidence and case files are within that root.
The artifact-derived case_id is attacker- or otherwise untrusted-input controllable and contains a traversal segment that escapes the generated runtime parent.
The selected out-of-root parent contains a regular file at the fixed suffix conf/request-body.bin that the generator process can read.
case_metadata() reaches request_body_bytes() for the record.
reproduction: Run the retained pre-fix probe against source baseline 9f23ae2c5fe908cef38f203be03f93fda75a8dd7 with PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, a task-owned TMPDIR, and a task-owned PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX.
The probe creates a safe-root evidence/case layout, a legitimate in-root runtime/legitimate-case/conf/request-body.bin, and an out-of-root outside/conf/request-body.bin sentinel.

Call case_metadata() once with case_id legitimate-case and once with case_id ../../../outside. The retained result records the in-root control and vulnerability_reproduced:true for the traversal case.

evidence.command: rtk proxy env PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=<task-tmp> PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=<task-pycache> /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python -B artifacts/03_validation/pre_fix_body_processor_path_probe.py
evidence.result: vulnerability_reproduced:true; traversal_preview was outside-root-sentinel and traversal_sha256 equaled outside_sha256 afeb199d897b997c4b32330b4fa18c6ae6694cd153edd9ddacabb6bcfbfa2c2b; legitimate_preview remained legitimate-in-root-body. No raw request body is retained.

evidence.command: rtk proxy env PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=<task-tmp> PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=<task-pycache> /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_focused_analysis_utils.py
evidence.result: The newly added focused regression failed as expected before the source fix: it expected fallback-body but received the out-of-root sentinel. This proves the actual case_metadata report-generation boundary, not only a helper-level pattern.

evidence.command: rtk proxy env PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=<task-tmp> PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=<task-pycache> /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python -B artifacts/03_validation/post_fix_body_processor_path_probe.py
evidence.result: A local candidate routed the body candidate through safe_existing_file(); traversal_preview and symlink_preview both fell back to fallback-body while the legitimate in-root preview remained readable. This is local remediation evidence only and does not change the finding status from validated.

evidence.command: Focused final security review of the local candidate exact diff
evidence.result: The local candidate's security review found no remaining candidate in the changed path. It is not delivery, exact-head hosted, master, or lifecycle verification evidence.

root_cause: The generator validates artifact evidence and the case file through safe_existing_file(), but treats the artifact-derived case_id as a path component and then constructs the sibling request-body candidate without reapplying that control. request_body_bytes() directly reads the candidate; generated_body_length() makes an unguarded is_file() probe before its separately gated read_text() call.
root_cause_de: Der Generator validiert Artefakt-Evidence und Case-Datei über safe_existing_file(), behandelt die artefaktabgeleitete Case-ID jedoch als Pfadkomponente und konstruiert danach den benachbarten Request-Body-Kandidaten ohne erneute Anwendung dieses Controls. request_body_bytes() liest den Kandidaten direkt; generated_body_length() führt vor seinem separat gegateten read_text()-Aufruf eine ungeschützte is_file()-Prüfung aus.
proposed_remediation: Make both generated_body_length() and request_body_bytes() resolve config_path.parent / request-body.bin through safe_existing_file() before inspecting or reading it. Add focused regression coverage for a traversal-bearing case ID and an in-root symlink that resolves outside, plus a legitimate in-root body; preserve the existing fallback body behavior and the configured safe-root control. Do not weaken report-path validation or broaden allowed roots.
proposed_remediation_de: Sowohl generated_body_length() als auch request_body_bytes() müssen config_path.parent / request-body.bin vor Prüfung oder Read über safe_existing_file() auflösen. Fokussierte Regression-Coverage für eine traversalhaltige Case-ID und einen In-Root-Symlink, der nach außerhalb auflöst, sowie einen legitimen In-Root-Body ergänzen; bestehendes Fallback-Body-Verhalten und das konfigurierte Safe-Root-Control bewahren. Report-Path-Validierung nicht abschwächen und erlaubte Roots nicht erweitern.
acceptance_criteria: The original ../../../outside reproduction no longer returns an external request-body preview or SHA-256.

A traversal-bearing case_id and an in-root request-body symlink resolving outside cannot cause request_body_bytes() to disclose content outside configured safe roots; both body helpers consistently reject the derived candidate.
A legitimate in-root request-body.bin remains readable and produces the same metadata as before.
Fallback body behavior remains correct when the generated body file is rejected or absent.
Focused local tests and a security-diff review pass without changing safe-root policy, report-output containment, scanner rules, exclusions, suppressions, or Quality Gates.
validation_plan: Run the retained baseline reproducer or an equivalent focused test against the repaired source and assert that the former traversal condition is rejected.
Exercise a legitimate in-root request-body file through the same case_metadata() boundary.
Exercise an in-root request-body symlink that resolves outside and verify that the fixed suffix still cannot select an out-of-root file.
Run the focused body-processor utility/report tests, Python compilation, and a security-diff review of the exact repair.
regression_tests: Focused case_metadata path-boundary test for a traversal-bearing case_id and an in-root request-body symlink resolving outside (added with the local candidate; delivery verification remains pending).
Focused legitimate in-root request-body metadata control through case_metadata().
legitimate_control_tests: An in-root runtime/legitimate-case/conf/request-body.bin is read and its metadata is preserved.
A record with no generated body file continues to use its supported request-body fallback.
Evidence and case files within the configured safe root remain accepted.
deduplication_note: Distinct from FND-PARENT-0026 because this finding is a concrete read-path bypass in one body-processor report generator rather than broad caller-controlled runtime roots; distinct from FND-PARENT-0034 because it concerns bounded out-of-root reads, not report publication writes or symlink clobbering.
residual_risk: The baseline source permits the bounded out-of-root content read through request_body_bytes() described above until a repair is verified. Local candidate evidence is retained, but this record does not claim a fixed/verified status, a PR, delivery, merge, master result, normal hosted-CI attacker reachability, secret exposure, or risk acceptance.
residual_risk_de: Der Baseline-Source erlaubt bis zur verifizierten Reparatur den beschriebenen begrenzten Out-of-Root-Content-Read über request_body_bytes(). Lokale Candidate-Evidence wird aufbewahrt, aber dieser Record beansprucht weder Status fixed/verified noch PR, Delivery, Merge, Master-Ergebnis, normale Hosted-CI-Angreiferreichweite, Secret-Exposition oder Risikoakzeptanz.

history.detail: A safe-root-configured probe used an artifact-derived traversal case_id to expose an out-of-root fixed-suffix request-body sentinel while preserving the legitimate in-root control.
The local candidate rejected traversal and symlink variants and passed final diff review, but it remains unverified local evidence; finding status is intentionally validated, not fixed or verified.
